content.text:
I'd go with א, the coin towers. Pretty sure. What decided it: two big numbers side by side, **66,513 ₪** for קרן השתלמות against **19,595 ₪** for חשבון ניירות ערך, same 300 ₪ a month from me. The keren pile is mostly yellow, and I can tell that's the boss's money because it says "300 ₪ בחודש מכם, 900 ₪ מהמעסיק" right under it. That basically answers "is it worth it". It also has the "מומלץ" tag, but I'd have picked it anyway.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **The heading and the three cards up top.** "+900 ₪ בחודש" from the employer grabbed me first, so that's the number I judged everything else against. I glanced at the "+32,225 ₪" card and didn't read the rest.
- **The grey text under the cards** (the line starting "דוגמה: שכר ברוטו 12,000"). Skipped it.
- **Option א.** The two big totals, the toggle sitting on "שכירים", and the bar row with "לפני 6 שנים: מס" in pink and "מ-6 שנים: פטור ממס". I got the idea: wait 6 years and you pay no tax. I skimmed the table under it and read the bottom line, "נשאר בידיים".
- **The same chart again for year 6:** 98,738 against 23,973. That made it click even harder.
- **Option ב, the steps.** The red striped "מס במשיכה" block with "−13,974 ₪" made me nervous. "אותו כסף עובר לקרן +527" didn't mean much to me.
- **Option ג, the stacked columns.** Lots of colours with a legend at the top, so I'd have to keep looking up and down. There's also a white line, and I only guessed it's the securities account. I stopped there.

**Words I didn't get:** "רווח אחרי דמי ניהול", "מס במשיכה" (tax when I take it out? I wasn't sure), "פטור ממס", "מסלול 'מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד S&P500'", "קרן 'ילין לפידות מחקה'".

**What bothered me:**
- In א, the striped pink coins only get explained in the table further down. Every row there has a coloured dot, so I kept matching colours back and forth.
- I never worked out how much one coin is worth. It's only in the small grey line at the bottom.
- There's a big empty gap between "כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪…" and the coins. I almost thought the page had ended.
- The "−13,974 ₪" tax in the keren is scary. If I'd seen that first I might have dropped the whole idea.
- At ג I'd have closed the page.
